rules.sentence: Pulmonary hypertension is defined as a mean pulmonary arterial pressure ≥ 25 mm Hg at rest or ≥ 35 mm
Diagnosis is made by measuring pulmonary artery pressure.
Treatment is with vasodilators and diuretics.
In some advanced cases, lung transplantation is an option.
Prognosis is poor overall if a treatable secondary cause is not found.
